STANZA I
How vast the treasure we possess
How vast the treasure we possess!
How rich thy bounty, King of Grace!
This world is ours, and worlds to come
Earth is our lodge, and heaven our home.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Where Watts found it
Watts printed the hymn under 1 Corinthians 3:21. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Therefore, stop boasting in men. All things are yours, 1 CORINTHIANS 3:21 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 1 CORINTHIANS 3
All things are ours, the gifts of God; The purchase of a Saviour's blood: While the good Spirit shews us how To use and to improve them too. STANZA II
